items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR Adonai Mitchell for Sunday vs. Bears.
items.why: Quad injury from Week 3; official Friday ruling.
items.implication: Braelon Allen expected to lead Jets backfield; Wilson target share boost likely with Mitchell also out.
items.opportunity: Lead RB snaps/carries to backup; WR1 volume to Garrett Wilson.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels officially out Sunday; Marcus Mariota starts vs. Colts.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow recovery; practiced in brace but not ready.
items.implication: Mariota remains starter; Commanders pass catchers face lower ceiling.
items.opportunity: No change for Daniels handcuff; Mariota streaming spot vs. Colts.

items.text: With Dylan Sampson (knee) out virtually all season, Quinshon Judkins has seen 13.8% target share (vs 8.3% prior); on pace for 64 catches after 26 last year.
items.why: 4-game sample with primary pass-catching back out; elevated receiving role.
items.implication: Judkins becomes higher-upside PPR RB with dual-threat usage.
items.opportunity: 13.8% target share + carries; third-down/route work expansion.

items.text: Jaylen Warren on LOVE list as top-10 play: 90% snap rate, 20/22 RB touches last week; Dowdle out again; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game.
items.why: Workhorse usage on short week; matchup vs. Browns run defense.
items.implication: Must-start RB1/RB2 despite short week concerns.
items.opportunity: Near-monopoly snaps/carries with Dowdle OUT; third-down role.

items.text: Drake London LOVE: 35% career target share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) last week; NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Hyper-targeted by Penix; elite volume in favorable matchup.
items.implication: WR1 lock with massive target share.
items.opportunity: 35%+ target share, red-zone looks under Penix.

items.text: Garrett Wilson LOVE: Mitchell likely out again; 36% target share last time Mitchell sidelined; 78% catch rate, 9.0 YPT; CHI allows 14+ YPR.
items.why: Clear WR1 volume with Mitchell OUT; strong efficiency vs. soft CHI secondary.
items.implication: Elevated WR2/flex with Hall also out limiting run game.
items.opportunity: 36% target share potential; routes without competition.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip/groin) returned to limited practice; McVay expects him to play Week 4 vs Eagles (corroborated widely).
items.why: Progress in recovery; full expectation from coach after limited practice.
items.implication: Immediate WR1 restart if active; monitor final status.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets as WR1 vs solid Eagles matchup for WRs.

items.text: Fresh ETR Rest of Season rankings live: Kenneth Walker ranked RB/overall #3; other notables Parker Washington #22, Saquon #30. Trade calculator updated.
items.why: Post-Week 3 usage and opportunity adjustments if season restarted today.
items.implication: Strong buy signal on Walker; elevated trade value.
items.opportunity: Featured back role and efficiency supporting elite ROS rank.

items.text: Josh Downs LOVE: 31% target share last two games, 43% red-zone looks; WAS allows most FPts and TDs to WRs/slot.
items.why: Surging volume and red-zone role vs. worst WR defense.
items.implication: Strong WR3/flex start in London game.

items.text: George Kittle LOVE: climbing target share/routes (27% W3); Evans day-to-day ribs; DEN allows 8th-most TE yards.
items.why: Rising usage; potential Evans absence boosts TE targets.
items.opportunity: Route participation and target share climb; red-zone.

items.text: Trevor Lawrence LOVE @ CIN: 19+ FPts in 8/9 recent; highest O/U 51.5; prior vs CIN 271/3 TDs.
items.why: Elite recent form and shootout environment vs. Bengals.

items.text: Justin Herbert HATE @ SEA: 44% pressure rate; SEA 4th pressure, league-low 5.0 YPA/7.7 YPC; bottom-3 implied total.
items.why: Harsh matchup vs. elite SEA pass rush/coverage; low team total.
items.opportunity: Limited due to pressure and defensive scheme.

items.text: Omarion Hampton HATE @ SEA: RB27 utilization, 3.5% tgt, 25% routes, 42% snaps W3 (13% 3rd down); SEA 2.9 YPC allowed.
items.why: Declining role/usage; elite run defense matchup.
items.opportunity: Low snaps, routes, targets; poor efficiency spot.

items.text: Kyle Pitts has six targets through three games, none inside the 10, low aDOT; among biggest underperformers of actual opportunity.
items.why: Low volume and inefficient target quality under Penix so far.
items.implication: Fade or sell-low; TE depth chart/role not translating.
items.opportunity: Minimal red-zone/goal-line; low aDOT limits upside.
